Subject: Private hosting technical deep-dive & network prerequisites

Hi Ben — thanks again for a productive discovery this morning. Quick recap + next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of needs from our call:
- Private/VPC deployment (customer-managed VPC) with HIPAA controls and KMS integration.
- Primary region: us-west-2.
- Expected steady-state: ~30 QPS inference with peaks to ~120 QPS, median sequence length 256 tokens.
- Persistence: logs retained 90 days; entity extraction outputs do not leave the VPC.

Proposed next step:
- 60–90 minute technical deep-dive (ops + infra + runtime) to align architecture, network prerequisites, and a mutual action plan. We'll walk the Pre-Call Checklist and surface any gaps before a pilot.

Available windows (PST) next week from our side:
- Tue 11/18: 09:00–11:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Wed 11/19: 10:00–12:00

Can you share 2 preferred slots that work for your infra and security teams? Also please include the primary network contact (and their email) so we can share IP ranges and VPN details in advance.

I attached a short Pre-Call Checklist to make the call efficient. If you have a preferred agenda items list, drop it in a reply and we'll fold it in.

Thanks — looking forward to lining this up.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Hi Ben — Connor from Redwood runtime/ops team here. Thanks for moving this forward. A few quick items ahead of the call: 

- IP ranges: For the dedicated/private runtime we provide a stable set of egress IPs per deployment. I'll circulate the exact CIDR blocks once we provision the reserved pool for your account; for planning purposes, you can allow outbound to: 34.201.0.0/16 and 52.44.0.0/16 (these are placeholder ranges we commonly use — final list will be narrower).
- Connectivity options: we support site-to-site VPN, AWS PrivateLink (if you're in the same account/partner setup), or managed peering. If you plan to do a VPN, please share your gateway public IP and preferred cipher suite.
- Ports: allow outbound HTTPS (443) and additional health-check ports we list in the checklist.

Agenda suggestion for the 90-minute deep-dive:
1) Intro & scope (5m)
2) Architecture overview (20m) — runtime, KV cache, scaling knobs
3) Network & security walk-through (25m) — IP ranges, KMS, audit logs
4) Deployment flow & pilot plan (20m) — timelines, staging
5) Q&A & mutually-agreed next steps (20m)

We can run the session with Priya + me + Mina. I'll bring our runtime lead for the architecture segment. If Arjun wants specific items covered (e.g., HSM integration or on-prem airgap), flag them and we'll prioritize.

Link to our internal Private Hosting runbook for reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-priv-hosting-reference

Connor Obrien
